description: Profile-guided text metric, line-break scratch, decoded image and project-glyph preparation optimizations. No whole-document layout cache.

sourceChangingEdits.description: Median of three trials, each with 21 alternating batches and eight source variants per scenario. Stable project files uploaded once. Timings exclude PDF generation; PDFs are fingerprint-checked for every variant before measurement.
sourceChangingEdits.imageFixture: 768x512 RGBA PNG; decode cache is warm, not initial image upload/compile
sourceChangingEdits.outlier: The first trial flagged a 5.8% bibliography slowdown; two fresh-process repeat trials were about 7% faster. All samples and the failed gate are retained, not discarded.

boundsAndInvalidation.textMetrics: 512 direct-mapped entries (~16 KiB), full font/scale/document-point-size key; only immutable built-in ASCII glyphs are cached
boundsAndInvalidation.lineBreakScratch: Reusable per-engine temporary storage; recomputed for every paragraph
boundsAndInvalidation.decodedImages: LRU, at most 32 entries and 16 MiB retained encoded-image data; cleared by project file registration/replacement; requested dimensions remain per-use
boundsAndInvalidation.projectGlyphPreparation: Repeated edits do not rescan unchanged project text; invalidated when files or fonts are registered

notes: Native book sampling identified text metric lookup and paragraph line breaking as major costs; sample is in bench/.work/perf-cache/sample.txt.
Caches reuse resources, not completed document layouts. Every timed edit reparses and lays out its changed source.
Measured speed comparisons isolate the WASM changes using the same JS wrapper; no standalone speed claim is made for the project Unicode scan optimization.
Timing checks used the existing 5% noise allowance and ran without concurrent test or reference compiler workloads.
The 185 corpus PDFs remain warning-bearing diagnostic renders, not proof of full LaTeX parity.
